scientific_rationale.post_b_side_residual: no robust cross-year side or draw correction survived residual diagnostics; do not mutate B 1X2 probabilities
scientific_rationale.post_b_importance_residual: PIT table-importance features improved low-score binary logloss in both 2021 and 2022 rolling tests
scientific_rationale.score_shape_residual: balanced matches underpredicted 1-1 while strong-gap matches overpredicted <=2-goal mass
scientific_rationale.design: score-matrix-only calibration with exact B 1X2 region preservation

candidate_family.importance_low2: fit fixed-ridge offset logistic correction to total-goals<=2 using PIT importance_diff and importance_mean; apply correction as within-1X2-region low-score exponential tilt
candidate_family.regime_shape: train-derived balance quintiles; balanced bottom quintile gets intercept-only 1-1 cell tilt within draw region; strong-gap top quintile gets intercept-only <=2-goal tilt within each 1X2 region
candidate_family.combined: importance_low2 then regime_shape sequentially, preserving every 1X2 region after each transform

selection_rule.rank: lowest mean rolling exact-score logloss delta, then lowest mean total-goals logloss delta, then contract candidate order
